title: Senior Decision Scientist, Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, your work will have a tangible impact on the real world, empowering Vinted’s members to lead more sustainable lives. You will play a key role in shaping our product and business strategy by leveraging data to drive impactful decision-making.</p> <p>Decision Scientists at Vinted are distributed across our family of domains: Strategy &amp; Planning, Marketing, Member Lifecycle, Buyer, Seller, Pricing &amp; Revenue, Purchase, Order, Payments, Trust &amp; Safety, Security, Help Experience, Vinted Go OpsTech, Vinted Go Points, and Vinted Go Network, either embedded in cross-functional product teams or as part of data teams, collaborating closely with colleagues to identify opportunities, generate insights, and improve member experiences.</p> <p>Vinted’s Marketing domain is growing - we’re on a mission to make Vinted known and loved as the go-to destination for everything second-hand. Marketing is one of the primary drivers behind our biggest strategic goals, from winning the USA market to expanding beyond fashion into a multi-vertical platform.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Decision Scientist to join our Marketing team to help guide high-stakes decisions across our channels and markets. As part of this team, you will shape data-driven media investment decisions through (Bayesian) Media Mix Modelling, uplift testing and attribution modelling. You will apply statistical and econometric techniques to untangle causal relationships that translate to clear insights and decisions.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Improve Marketing Intelligence:</strong> Lead the development of our attribution modelling, (Bayesian) Media Mix Models (MMM) and member engagement marketing measurement, partnering with experts to evolve our ROI and payback frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Guide Investment Decisions:</strong> Bring data-driven input to high-stakes investment decisions across channels and markets, working closely with marketing leaders.</li> <li><strong>Validate Strategic Bets:</strong> Identify growth opportunities and answer critical business questions by designing rigorous tests and analysing impact using advanced statistical methods.</li> <li><strong>Scale Decision-Making:</strong> Design and deploy automated data products and self-service tools that empower the domain to make data-driven decisions independently and at scale.</li> <li><strong>Champion Data Excellence:</strong> Oversee key performance indicators and promote analytics best practices, ensuring our data culture translates directly into business results.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong foundational experience (4-8 years)</strong> in data science, analytics, or a similar field. Experience in marketing analytics and measurement is a great benefit, but not a must.</li> <li><strong>A strategic mindset:</strong> You don't just provide data; you connect scientific findings to pragmatic business solutions that drive real-world growth.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> You can define the right problem to solve and the right approach, even when the path isn't laid out for you.</li> <li><strong>Great communicator:</strong> You are skilled at influencing stakeholders and can present complex modelling results in a persuasive way to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li><strong>Strong technical proficiency:</strong> Proficient in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience using dbt and BI tools (like Looker or Tableau) to build scalable data products.</li> <li><strong>Strong theoretical foundation:</strong> Deep knowledge of principles behind data science, including statistical modelling, regression analysis and causal inference.</li> <li><strong>Educational background:</strong> A graduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Math, Economics, Econometrics or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>Excellent written and spoken English.</li> <li><em>Advantage:</em> Previous experience with Media Mix Modelling (MMM), advanced attribution methods, CRM analytics and Bayesian statistics.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks&nbsp; </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong></p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€74.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€100.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

As we enjoy incredible brand equity and awareness – particularly in our home market of Germany – you won't be starting from zero. Instead, you will inherit a premium, high-performing base to steer our consumer brand into its next major iteration: moving toward a broader, lifestyle and community-driven positioning. A core focus of this role will be emphasizing the "Club" in Urban Sports Club. We are a community-driven concept, not just a utility app for solo check-ins. In this hybrid role, you will sit firmly on both the strategic/conceptual side and the operational frontlines. You will champion the evolution of the brand to maximize consumer appeal, while simultaneously developing and executing the concrete marketing strategies that bring our community vision to life. Your most exciting challenge? Internationalization – translating our proven local formula into scalable, culturally resonant consumer strategies for diverse international markets. Strengthen the "Club": Ensure campaigns and activations reinforce the community aspect of our brand, creating emotional connections that highlight shared experiences and lifestyle rather than just functional access. Balance Strategy & Execution: Own the brand marketing strategy end-to-end, steering its execution across multi-channel campaigns, PR, Content, and Social Media. Lead Internationalization: Translate, adapt, and scale the core brand strategy across international B2C markets, balancing global consistency with deep local cultural relevance. Steer the Creative Studio & Teams: Oversee and mentor our multi-disciplinary brand teams and internal creative studio, fostering innovation, efficiency, and high-impact creative excellence. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary strategic brand stakeholder across the organization, collaborating closely with all marketing leaders to align brand priorities with business objectives. Insights & Budget Management: Efficiently manage the global brand budget while monitoring key health metrics (awareness, sentiment, share of voice) to turn consumer insights into optimized campaign performance. What you will need to succeed 10+ years of experience leading brand management, marketing, or integrated communications, ideally within lifestyle, community or fast-paced B2C consumer industries. Proven track record of developing scalable international brand strategies and managing large-scale, multi-channel campaigns. Strategic & Execution Hybrid Mindset: Ability to alternate seamlessly between high-level conceptual brand building and concrete, hands-on campaign delivery. Community-First Approach: A strong understanding of consumer brand positioning, audience engagement, and culturally relevant storytelling that builds community. Exceptional Leadership: Strong experience leading cross-functional creative teams, PR specialists, and content creators, alongside managing external agencies. Analytical & Financial Rigor: A data-driven approach to tracking brand performance metrics, translating market research into action, and managing complex global budgets. Language Proficiency: Full fluency in English is required; German language skills are a significant plus. Flexible Work Model:  Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle. Extended Remote Work Options:  Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices. Personal Development:  Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes. Wir schaffen ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld – Unser modernes Büro, nur wenige Minuten vom Berliner Gendarmenmarkt entfernt, bietet dir eine top Lage und eine produktive Atmosphäre. Wir fördern Teamspirit & Spaß – Regelmäßige Teamevents - von Bootstouren über Exit-Rooms bis hin zum Kletterwald und Vision-Workshops - sorgen für Abwechslung und stärken unseren Zusammenhalt. raw.description:
Worum es geht

Wir haben mit Tomorrow Großes vor! Unsere Vision: Nachhaltige Finanzen raus aus der Nische holen und in die Mitte der Gesellschaft bringen. Das ist verdammt viel Arbeit, also packen wir es an.

Hinter unserer Banking-App steht ein Backend, das jeden Tag echtes Geld für echte Menschen bewegt, sicher und zuverlässig. Als Senior Backend Engineer (w/m/d) in einem crossfunktionalen Produktteam, dem Team hinter Banking, Transaktionen und Investieren, gestaltest du die Services im Herzen davon mit. Du arbeitest an einem JVM-Backend (Kotlin und Java, Spring Boot), das auf sauberer Domänenmodellierung, ereignisgetriebenen Services und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch aufbaut, in einem regulierten Finanzumfeld, in dem Korrektheit und Vertrauen nicht verhandelbar sind.

Du arbeitest in einem agilen Umfeld mit regelmäßigen Releasezyklen eng und proaktiv mit anderen Backend- und Mobile-Entwickler*innen, Designer*innen und Business Owner*innen zusammen. Unsere flache Organisationsstruktur und schlanken Entscheidungsprozesse fördern eine praktische, kooperative Atmosphäre, in der dein Input die Architektur, unsere Arbeitsweise und die Menschen um dich herum mitgestaltet.

Wir entwickeln in Zusammenarbeit mit KI. Coding-Tools leben direkt in unseren Repositories, mit Leitplanken und menschlichem Review, und du bleibst verantwortlich für das, was live geht. Wir suchen dich, wenn du diese Tools gut anleitest, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch hinterfragst und die Kontrolle über das Ergebnis behältst. Und wenn du dem ganzen Team hilfst, hier besser zu werden: indem du unser AI Harness (die wiederverwendbaren Tools und Leitplanken rund um die Modelle) mitgestaltest und Praktiken teilst, statt sie für dich zu behalten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Backend-Services in unserer Produkt-Domäne entwerfen, bauen und weiterentwickeln (Banking, Transaktionen, Investieren)
  • Komplexe Finanzdomänen sauber modellieren und unsere Architektur gesund halten, während sie wächst
  • Den Anspruch an Testing, Zuverlässigkeit und Observability hochhalten und anderen dabei helfen
  • An Code-Reviews, Incident-Management und sicheren, gut koordinierten Releases teilnehmen
  • Unser AI Harness nutzen und weiterentwickeln und das, was funktioniert, mit dem gesamten Engineering-Team teilen


Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Erfahrung darin, Features oder Epics von der Idee bis zur Produktion zu bringen. Du hast einen echten Teil eines Produkts verantwortet, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit anderen.
  • Backend-Tiefe in Produktion. Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Bauen und Betreiben von Produktions-Backend-Services auf der JVM (Kotlin und/oder Java mit Spring Boot), inklusive ereignisgetriebener Systeme (z. B. Kafka), PostgreSQL und Testing als Gewohnheit.
  • Du machst Teams besser. Du kommunizierst klar und reviewst, pairst, mentorst und widersprichst konstruktiv.
  • Du arbeitest gut mit KI. Du kannst KI-Coding-Tools anleiten, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen und die Verantwortung für das behalten, was live geht. Bonus: Du hast schon wiederverwendbares Tooling (ein „AI Harness") gebaut oder geteilt, das ein Team schneller gemacht hat.
  • Du sprichst fließend Englisch, unsere Unternehmenssprache. Deutsch ist keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du stehst hinter der Idee, Geld als Hebel für positiven Wandel zu nutzen.
  • Bonus: Erfahrung in einem regulierten oder sicherheitskritischen Umfeld (Fintech, Banking, Payments, Health o. Ä.).

Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du jeden Punkt erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wenn dich diese Rolle und die Mission begeistern, hören wir lieber von dir, als dass du dich selbst aussortierst.


Was wir anbieten

Es wird Spaß machen, versprochen. Mit mehr als 50 Überzeugungstäter*innen arbeitest du bei Tomorrow jeden Tag daran, Menschen für nachhaltige Finanzen zu begeistern. Unsere Kultur basiert auf unseren Werten, gelebter New-Work-Philosophie und klaren, ambitionierten Zielen. Aber schreiben können wir hier viel, lern uns am besten einfach kennen und überzeuge dich selbst.


Vergütung

Diese Stelle ist eine 80%-Position. 56.000–62.400 € brutto pro Jahr, das sind 80% unserer Vollzeit-Spanne von 70.000–78.000 € für dieses Level.

Transparency is Queen (and King). Deshalb geben wir für alle Jobs eine Gehaltsspanne an. Eine individuelle Einschätzung und Eingruppierung in unsere transparente Gehaltsmatrix nehmen wir vor, sobald wir dich im Interview besser kennengelernt haben.


Von wo aus du arbeiten könntest

Wir möchten allen bei Tomorrow ermöglichen, ihre Lebens- und Arbeitszeit flexibel und unter Berücksichtigung der eigenen Lebensrealität zu gestalten. Home Office und Mobile Work sind fester Bestandteil unserer „remote-friendly" Arbeitskultur. Gleichzeitig glauben wir an die besondere Atmosphäre und Innovationskraft echter menschlicher Begegnung. Deshalb bitten wir dich, regelmäßig, mindestens einmal alle zwei Wochen, in unser Hamburger Office zu kommen. Es steht dir jederzeit als Arbeitsort zur Verfügung, ist barrierearm, hat einen ebenerdigen Zugang und bietet flexible Möglichkeiten, den Arbeitsplatz zu gestalten.

You bridge R&D and manufacturing to architect company-wide QA frameworks, enforce rigorous quality gates, and lead a high-performing team of engineers in elevating our physical and software products. By blending strategic vision with hands-on technical problem-solving, you ensure our field-ready autonomous robotics perform flawlessly in complex industrial environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Define Quality & Reliability Strategy: Architect end-to-end QA frameworks, test strategies, and reliability targets across engineering design, product development, and production.

  • Establish Gatekeeping Criteria: Define and enforce strict gate-review criteria across Design, New Product Introduction (NPI), and Production phases to guarantee compliance with performance and safety standards.

  • Bridge R&D and Manufacturing: Work closely with Engineering and Operations to integrate quality standards throughout product life cycles and End-of-Line (EOL) testing.

  • Lead & Empower the Team: Mentor and grow the team of quality and test engineers, and build a strong culture of quality excellence across multidisciplinary teams. Enable teams to fully own quality and reliability in their areas of focus via transparent, metrics-based accountability frameworks and dashboards.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you’ll be doing
Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a traditional box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part client whisperer. If you enjoy roles that stay static, this probably isn't it. Your mission is to help our clients, some of the most prestigious law firms in the world, get the absolute most out of our platform. Our DACH team is focussed on working with law firm teams across the DACH market and our Benelux team is focussed on law firm teams across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg.   • Documenting best practices from leading firms, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally.

  • Confidently helping law firms navigate one of the biggest shifts in how legal services are delivered - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different practice areas, from corporate to disputes.

What you bring

You come from the world of Big Law; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. Perhaps you've moved into legal innovation, knowledge management, or legal tech within a firm. Maybe you've even left private practice to disrupt the status quo through a legal tech company, or ventures of your own. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe. Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an. Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
description: At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms. As a Senior Robotics Engineer , you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments. Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation. Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness. Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions. Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces.  Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture. Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions. Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure. Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection. Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments. Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle. Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities. Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team. What you bring to the team: Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python. Experience developing embedded software in C/C++. Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including: Perception State estimation Sensor fusion Motion planning Feedback control Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2. Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors. Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV. Experience implementing real-time control systems. Experience with machine learning for robotic perception. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems. Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows. Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics. Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent English Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. title: Werkstudent UX Project Management & Design Operations (m/w/d)
description: Ab wann: Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Du liebst die Welt des UX-Designs, hast jedoch mehr Spaß an Organisation und Kommunikation als am reinen Design-Prozess? Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass kreative Umsetzung und das Management von Kundenwünschen perfekt Hand in Hand gehen? Du hast Lust, deine Stärken in einem Startup-Team einzubringen, das über reine Designdienstleistung hinaus soziale und ökologische Verantwortung übernimmt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Peak Studio ist ein wachsendes Design-Startup mit Fokus auf Klarheit, Konsistenz und nachhaltige Wirkung. Wir glauben, dass Design Verantwortung trägt: gegenüber unseren Kunden ebenso wie gegenüber der Welt, in der wir leben. Deshalb entwickeln wir anstatt kurzlebiger Kampagnen ganzheitliche, zusammenhängende Markensysteme und skalierbare Strukturen, die Bestand haben. Unseren Kunden bieten wir Design auf Subscription-Basis über 3 maßgeschneiderte Abo Modelle an. Über einen zentralen, agilen Workflow liefern wir Ergebnisse schnell, konsistent und ohne das häufige Projektchaos. Aufgaben Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Design-Team strukturiert, unseren kundennahen Subscription-Workflow koordiniert und als kompetenter Ansprechpartner an der Kundenschnittstelle agiert. Deine Aufgaben bei uns: Schnittstelle & Kommunikation: Du bist das zentrale Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und dem internen UX/UI-Design-Team. Anforderungsmanagement: Du nimmst Kundenwünsche in Meetings auf, hinterfragst diese kritisch und übersetzt sie in klare, verständliche Briefings für die Designer. Projektkoordination: Du steuerst Design-Sprints, überwachst Timelines und organisierst die internen Feedbackschleifen. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Kunden-Präsentationen, moderierst Abstimmungstermine und stellst sicher, dass die Erwartungen auf beiden Seiten matchen. Qualifikation Passendes Studium: Du studierst aktuell im Master (z. B. UX-Design & Management, Design-Management, Strategic Design, oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang). Kommunikationstalent: Du hast großen Spaß am direkten Kundenkontakt, trittst professionell sowie selbstsicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für ein dynamisches Startup-Umfeld mit. Konzeptionelles UX-Verständnis: Da dein Schwerpunkt in der Organisation und Kommunikation liegt, steht ein Design-Portfolio für uns nicht im Vordergrund. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du UX-Methoden und die Logik von Designsystemen tiefgreifend verstehst, um mit Kunden und Designern auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren. Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine sichere und fließende Kommunikation auf Englisch (in Wort und Schrift). Benefits Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro im Herzen Münchens oder nach Absprache Remote zu arbeiten, um Job und Studium optimal zu vereinbaren. Projekt-Impact mit Sinn: Unser Anspruch endet nicht beim Design. Wir verbinden effektive Gestaltung mit sozialer und ökologischer Verantwortung. Mit unserer Arbeit unterstützen wir unter anderem den Schutz von Ökosystemen und die Stärkung indigener Gemeinschaften in Südamerika und Asien. Mitgestaltung: Die Möglichkeit, die operativen Strukturen und Workflows einer wachsenden Designagentur von Grund auf aktiv mitzugestalten. Teamkultur: Ein ambitioniertes Team, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedbackkultur auf Augenhöhe. Entwicklung: Eine steile Lernkurve im Bereich Design Operations und agilem Projektmanagement sowie regelmäßiger, direkter Austausch mit den Gründern. Die Rolle und unsere Philosophie sprechen dich an, du bist dir jedoch nicht sicher, ob du alle Punkte erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem – möglicherweise bringst du genau das mit, von dem wir noch gar nicht wissen, dass wir es brauchen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
description: At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms. As a Senior Robotics Engineer , you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments. Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation. Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness. Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions. Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture. Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions. Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure. Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection. Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments. Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle. Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities. Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team. What you bring to the team: Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python. Experience developing embedded software in C/C++. Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including: Perception State estimation Sensor fusion Motion planning Feedback control Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2. Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors. Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV. Experience implementing real-time control systems. Experience with machine learning for robotic perception. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems. Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows. Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics. Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. raw.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Head of Learning & Product Expansion (w/m/d) verantwortest Du die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung unseres Learning-Portfolios und unserer Prozesse im deutschsprachigen Markt. Du verbindest Markt- und Produktperspektive, befähigst unsere Learning-Organisation in Deutschland und stellst sicher, dass unsere AI-, Data- und Engineering-Programme als produktisierte Services wachsen, die skalierbar, compliant und kommerziell erfolgreich sind.

Du kommst zu Stackfuel und Multiverse in einer entscheidenden Phase ihrer Wachstumsgeschichte. Dich begeistert die Vision, Teil eines europäischen Scale-ups zu sein und Dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit bietet, im Netzwerk die Zukunft des Lernens mitzugestalten. Du denkst Lernen nicht nur als Inhalte und Curricula, sondern als Produkt, das skalieren, neue Märkte erschließen und sich an regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen anpassen kann. Themen wie Product-Market-Fit, die Grenzen dessen, wo Bildung und Technologie reale Weiterbildung transformieren können, und das Finden sowie Fördern der richtigen Talente in deinem Team treiben dich an.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle:

 

Produkt- & Portfoliostrategie (DACH & Europa)

  • Verantwortung für das deutschsprachige Learning-Portfolio und die Roadmap mit klarem Fokus auf Marktbedarfe und exzellente Lernerfahrungen

  • Befähigung Deines Team, neue Chancen in AI, Data und Engineering zu analysieren und in Programme mit belastbaren Business Cases zu übersetzen – dabei wirst Du auch selbst operativ bei wichtigen Kund:innen aktiv

  • Aufbau datengetriebener Routinen, um die Produktqualität beim Skalieren zu überwachen und die Priorisierung von Wartung und Weiterentwicklung zu steuern

AI-native Learning & Automatisierungsstrategien

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung einer AI-unterstützten Content-Produktionspipeline gemeinsam mit Expert:innen im Multiverse-Netzwerk und deinem Team (z. B. Agents, automatisierte Workflows, AI-basierte Analytics)

  • Einsatz von Daten, KPIs und Automatisierungstools zur Steuerung von Portfolio-Performance, Programmqualität und Skalierbarkeit

  • Aktive Erkundung neuer Formen dynamischer, AI-nativer Lernerfahrungen gemeinsam mit dem UK-Learning-Team und lokalen Expert:innen

Teambuilding & skalierbare Delivery

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Learning und anderen Bereichen: Weitergabe wichtiger Updates, Eskalation von Risiken und Förderung einer Kultur der Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Unternehmen

  • Rekrutierung, Onboarding und disziplinarische Führung von Teammitgliedern, einschließlich Führungskräften

  • Begleitung des Teams durch Wachstum und Veränderung und Etablierung einer Kultur, die unsere Operating Principles lebt

  • Förderung einer „AI-first“-Kultur, in der Automatisierung genutzt wird, um Kapazitäten für komplexere Aufgaben zu schaffen

  • Steuerung flexibler Ressourcen (z. B. Content-Partnerschaften oder Freelancer), um Expertise und Delivery gezielt zu unterstützen

Skalierung & Internationalisierung unserer Learning-Produkte

  • Lokalisierung und Anpassung erfolgreicher UK-Programme für den DACH-Markt und weitere Regionen (Sprache, Regulierung, Zielgruppen, Pricing)

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren „Education-as-a-Service“-Angebots inklusive Programme, Plattform (LXP) und Services

  • Mitverantwortung für Go-to-Market-Strategien neuer Angebote und Segmente gemeinsam mit Product, Product Marketing und Sales

  • Aufbau wirkungsvoller Netzwerke mit UK- und europäischen Partnern, um deutsche Best Practices zu teilen und Impulse aus anderen Ländern aufzunehmen

 

Das bringst Du mit

 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Produktstrategie, Programm-/Portfoliomanagement oder Venture-/Business Building – idealerweise in EdTech, SaaS oder einem anderen technologiegetriebenen Umfeld

  • Nachweisliche Verantwortung für Portfolios oder Product Roadmaps inklusive Budgetierung, Ressourcenplanung und Skalierung

  • Hohe Technologieaffinität und Erfahrung mit AI-, Data- oder digitalen Plattformprodukten – du musst nicht selbst coden, kannst aber komplexe Lösungen schnell verstehen

  • Erfahrung im Markteintritt und in der Kommerzialisierung neuer Angebote (neue Länder, Segmente oder Geschäftsmodelle)

  • Vertrautheit mit regulierten Bildungsumfeldern (z. B. staatlich geförderte Trainings, Akkreditierungen) oder stark regulierten Branchen (Banken, Gesundheitswesen etc.)

  • Führungserfahrung in dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Organisationen und ein Track Record im Aufbau und Management cross-funktionaler Teams sowie externer Partner

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten, KPIs und AI-/Automatisierungstools zur Steuerung von Portfolio-Performance, Auslastung und Produktqualität

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills – du fühlst dich im Gespräch mit CTOs, CAIOs, HR-/L&D-Leiter:innen ebenso wohl wie mit internen Teams

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

You set the quality bar for all Apps design output, you hold it across teams, and you keep engineering pointed at the right work. You are the technical lead for apps design, accountable for the quality and velocity of what the apps designers produce, without managing them directly. This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it. Set the quality standard for apps design and hold it as a discipline, not a project. Make the bar visible where teams miss it, and close gaps across teams that you did not personally create. You are accountable for the quality and velocity of all apps design output. Run planning and discovery for all three teams. Break multi-team, loosely defined problems into clear design direction the designers can run with. Partner with the Director of Product for Apps and the apps PMs on core initiatives, influencing roadmap and prioritization through design rationale. Lead native craft across iOS and Android. Set the approach for resizability, foldables, new screen sizes, and solve how KAYAK responds to platform chrome shifts like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive. Lead the design approach for mobile AI features: how we integrate AI into the apps, the UI, and the navigation around it, so it lands as a native part of the experience. Drive the brand differentiation work for our portfolio of hero brands apps like momondo to ensure local market dominance. Raise the ceiling for the other apps designers through critique, shared standards, and patterns they build on. Designers should get better by working alongside you and using what you establish, not only through direct mentorship. Required Skills 10+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped, high-impact mobile work at consumer scale. Deep native expertise across iOS and Android. Mastery of Apple HIG and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to converge and when to honor platform difference. Hands-on experience with resizability, foldables, and iPad, and a point of view on platform chrome directions like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3><strong>About Axon</strong></h3> <p>Axon’s mission is simple and bold: <strong>Protect Life</strong>.</p> <p>We build technology that helps first responders, security teams, and communities act with speed, clarity, and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security, and international agencies detect, assess, and respond to threats.</p> <p>Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors, and location data into a unified operating picture, accessible on any device. Alerts and presence are the heartbeat of that picture. They determine what demands attention and who is in position to act. We're building intelligent, high-signal alerting and presence experiences that cut through noise and keep operators and responders locked into what matters most.</p> <h3><strong>Your Impact</strong></h3> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Alerts &amp; Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus surfaces the right information to the right people at the right time - making alerts and responder presence the connective tissue of real-time operations.</p> <p>You'll build the systems that determine what warrants attention, how it's prioritized and routed, and how operators maintain awareness of who is where. This spans alert generation from cameras, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party sources, as well as the presence layer that tracks responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity.</p> <p>Your work will enable officers, security teams, and emergency responders around the world to cut through noise, act on what matters, and coordinate with confidence. By making alerts smarter and presence data seamless, your work will help prevent harm, accelerate response, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the Alerts &amp; Presence product roadmap, focused on delivering the right information at the right time to operators and responders</li> <li>Define how alerts are generated, prioritized, routed, and resolved across video, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party integrations</li> <li>Build presence experiences that give operators real-time visibility into responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity</li> <li>Design fast, intuitive workflows for monitoring incidents, triaging alerts, and coordinating response</li> <li>Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency, and reliable alerting and presence features across web and mobile</li> <li>Engage global law enforcement and enterprise users to validate needs and test improvements</li> <li>Align with other product teams to ensure alerts and presence data flow seamlessly across the platform</li> <li>Use metrics and feedback to refine roadmap priorities - reducing alert fatigue, improving time-to-action, and increasing situational awareness</li> <li>Support go-to-market, training, and rollout with cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Operators and responders receive timely, high-signal alerts that drive faster, more confident decisions</li> <li>Presence data gives commanders and dispatchers clear visibility into who is where - improving coordination and resource deployment</li> <li>Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention, and positive field feedback</li> <li>Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams, and the public</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years working on real-time, event-driven, or alerting systems</li> <li>Experience building products where speed, clarity, and reliability directly impact outcomes</li> <li>Strong grasp of alerting frameworks, geolocation and presence systems, real-time data pipelines, and notification design</li> <li>Familiarity with live video, sensor networks, LPR, drone telemetry, and IoT integrations</li> <li>Track record of turning user insights into clear product direction and focused execution</li> <li>Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through roadmap, design, delivery, and iteration</li> <li>Clear communicator who drives alignment, decisions, and measurable outcomes</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Axon</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Shape the future of public-private security collaboration, creating safer outcomes for communities and organizations.</li> <li>Join a mission-driven company with a history of innovation and impact.</li> <li>Work alongside passionate teams building technology that protects lives.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits that Benefit You</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Competitive base salary and RSUs</li> <li>Pension plan with matching contributions</li> <li>Private health insurance and cash plans</li> <li>30 days paid holiday plus UK public holidays</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>GymPass subscription</li> <li>Life assurance and income protection</li> <li>Career growth, learning support, and wellness resources</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use. title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
description: At NewOrbit Space, our mission is to engineer the lowest orbiting satellites on Earth to rapidly advance global connectivity and insight. We are currently building satellites that can operate at an altitude of just 200 km - one-third that of conventional satellites. Role Overview Responsible for the mechanical design of satellite structures, mechanisms, and related hardware from concept through qualification and on-orbit operation. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and validate them through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical systems and components for satellites, including primary structure, thermal-control hardware, secondary structures, and mechanisms. Generate 3D CAD models, fully dimensioned drawings, and interface control documents using GD&T, managing assembly configuration and PLM data. Take hardware from conceptual design through qualification to on-orbit operations, leading design reviews, and planning verification tests. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass, and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Support prototype builds, assembly, integration, and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems, and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, aerospace, or related engineering discipline. 5+ years’ experience in satellite mechanical design, including primary structure, pipe routing, electromechanics, and MGSE for aerospace applications (satellites, payloads, launch vehicles). Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks. Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials, structural mechanics, FEA ,and thermal management. Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering Space Technology – You'll contribute to launching groundbreaking technology into space. Your work on our revolutionary ion propulsion system and ULEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and disrupt traditional LEO operations. Unmatched Ownership and Impact – You'll experience a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry. You will participate in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and Competitive Salary – You'll receive not just a competitive salary but also company ownership stakes. Your dedication and hard work are rewarded with a share in the technology you help build, ensuring you're a part of our collective success. About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Senior Product Builder to help shape the future of the Connectors Experience by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who can independently take a vague problem, define what success looks like, and turn it into a shipped outcome - working directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and building in an AI-first environment. The role will start with a strong focus on the web app experience in Hub and Canvas (Web Modeler & Desktop Modeler), while also offering the opportunity over time to contribute across the stack where that enables faster end-to-end product delivery.

What You Will Do:

  • Discover and clarify meaningful user problems in the Connectors Experience by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Define success criteria and scope for features before build starts, rather than only executing a well-defined spec

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the Connectors Experience, owning complex features end-to-end

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Review AI-generated and peer output for maintainability, architectural fit, and UX quality, and share reusable patterns that raise the bar for other builders

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

  • Participate in an on-call rotation and 3rd level escalation support to ensure the system is meeting its objectives

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • Experience independently shipping complex products in a software environment, not just executing scoped tasks

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment, including helping others break down and sequence their work

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

Must Haves:

  • Hands-on experience independently building and shipping complex products in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to run AI-assisted workflows for complex features, diagnosing why AI output is weak and fixing the setup, not only the result

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly across a full feature or surface area, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations, catching pattern-level UX problems before they reach users

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to turn vague direction into a clear product approach, define success criteria, cut scope intelligently, and know when evidence is strong enough to proceed

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture: reviews implementation quality beyond “does it work”, evaluates maintainability, test coverage, and architectural fit, and contributes beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, operations tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with connector building, connector marketplaces and technical partnerships

  • Track record independently planning and running validation, synthesizing findings into concrete product or UX changes, and helping improve team practices around lightweight product validation

  • Experience mentoring other builders or raising the quality bar beyond your immediate team

Leading an agile team, you will be responsible for setting the strategy and vision for how we approach Creator Marketing at a global and local level. You’ll have a deep understanding of culture and what drives it to increase On’s brand visibility and actively influence the conversations that drive key business results.</p> <p><strong>Role description</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and implement a cohesive Creator strategy that elevates how we approach sourcing, briefing and directing Creators to deliver entertaining and interesting on-brand assets efficiently for organic and paid media teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead an engaged team of Specialists to inspire new thinking and ideas - setting up the vision for the team and working closely on bringing it to life.&nbsp;</li> <li>Establish a commissioning framework for a diverse mix of creators (defining content pillars and themes across our verticals).&nbsp; With commissions designed to capture attention and build our premium brand identity amongst our target communities.</li> <li>Move at the speed of culture to spot emerging creators, subcultures, and platform shifts early, and mobilise creators with agility to capitalize on moments before they pass.&nbsp;</li> <li>Establish clear KPIs for creator initiatives (across brand equity, engagement, and conversion). description: <p>We are seeking a Senior Staff Information Security Engineer to help shape and advance security across our hybrid technology estate.</p> <p>Our environment spans AWS and on-premises infrastructure hosted in colocation facilities. You will provide senior technical leadership across both environments, defining secure architecture patterns, building scalable controls, and partnering with Engineering, Product, SRE, and Infrastructure teams to reduce risk without creating unnecessary barriers to delivery.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will remain hands-on while acting as a trusted technical authority for complex security architecture and engineering decisions. You will lead initiatives that cross teams and technologies, address systemic security challenges, and improve how security is designed and implemented across the organisation.</p> <p>The role is primarily remote, with occasional in-person responsibilities at our Bristol, UK office and, where necessary, our colocation facilities.</p> <p><br><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <h4>Lead Infrastructure Security Architecture</h4> <ul> <li>Define and evolve security architecture across AWS and our colocation estate.</li> <li>Establish secure reference architectures, engineering standards, and reusable control patterns.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership for major infrastructure, platform, and product initiatives.</li> <li>Identify systemic risks and lead practical, sustainable programmes to address them.</li> </ul> <h4>Strengthen Cloud and Hybrid Security</h4> <ul> <li>Design and improve security across cloud accounts, networks, identities, workloads, and shared services.</li> <li>Establish effective controls for identity and access management, segmentation, encryption, secrets, logging, monitoring, and workload protection.</li> <li>Develop preventative guardrails through infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, automation, and cloud-native security services.</li> <li>Improve consistency across the enterprise including cloud, on-premises infrastructure, and the connectivity between them.</li> </ul> <h4>Partner with Engineering and Product</h4> <ul> <li>Engage early in the design of new products, platforms, services, and integrations.</li> <li>Lead threat modelling, security architecture reviews, and technical risk assessments.</li> <li>Translate security risks into clear, practical engineering recommendations.</li> <li>Help teams adopt secure-by-design principles through reusable patterns, tooling, and documentation.</li> </ul> <h4>Build, Automate, and Apply AI</h4> <ul> <li>Design and implement security tooling, integrations, and automated controls.</li> <li>Embed security capabilities into infrastructure provisioning, engineering workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li>Use AI-assisted tooling to improve scripting, detection development, alert analysis, vulnerability triage, threat modelling, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Validate AI-generated outputs and ensure AI tools are used with appropriate controls for confidentiality, accuracy, access, and human oversight.</li> </ul> <h4>Improve Risk Reduction and Resilience</h4> <ul> <li>Provide technical direction for vulnerability and exposure management across AWS and on-premises infrastructure.</li> <li>Identify recurring patterns across incidents, penetration tests, vulnerabilities, and control assessments.</li> <li>Act as a senior technical escalation point during significant security incidents.</li> <li>Ensure investigations and lessons learned result in durable architectural and engineering improvements.</li> </ul> <h4>Provide Senior Technical Leadership</h4> <ul> <li>Lead complex security initiatives spanning multiple teams and planning cycles.</li> <li>Mentor security engineers and provide guidance to engineers in adjacent teams.</li> <li>Raise the standard of security architecture, automation, documentation, and technical decision-making.</li> <li>Communicate security risks and recommendations clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience in security engineering, infrastructure security, cloud security, security architecture, or platform engineering.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on experience securing AWS environments.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of AWS identity and access management, network architecture, account governance, encryption, logging, monitoring, secrets management, and workload protection.</li> <li>Experience designing or securing on-premises, data-centre, or colocation-hosted infrastructure.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access, privileged administration, and hybrid connectivity.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, containerised environments, and cloud-native platforms.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automated security controls and engineering solutions.</li> <li>Proficiency with scripting or software development using Python, Go, or a comparable language.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI-assisted tooling to improve security engineering and operational workflows.</li> <li>Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering, infrastructure, or product teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of security architecture, threat modelling, vulnerability management, detection, and incident response.</li> <li>The ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions across technical and leadership audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable experience:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>An advanced AWS certification in security, architecture, networking, or cloud engineering.</li> <li>Experience in fintech, payments, SaaS, or another regulated technology environment.</li> <li>Experience securing large or complex AWS multi-account estates.</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes, container security, software supply-chain security, and policy-as-code.</li> <li>Experience with technologies such as CNAPP, CSPM, SIEM, EDR, DLP, WAF, vulnerability-management, network-security, or secrets-management platforms.</li> <li>Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, or ISO 27001.</li> <li>Experience supporting significant security incidents, penetration tests, audits, or customer security assessments</li> </ul> <h4><strong>As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary + bonus&nbsp;</li> <li>A remote first culture!</li> <li>Flex PTO&nbsp;</li> <li>Health, Dental and Vision Insurance</li> <li>13 Paid Holidays</li> <li>Company volunteer days</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do!</strong></p> <p>NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. We’re all about enabling more payments in more ways and more places.</p> <p>We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. We’re focused on making NMI more diverse and welcoming with initiatives like having a dedicated Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion action group, diversity goals for hiring, anonymized resume screening, affinity groups such as our Women's network and LGBTQ+ Network, open forums for discussions on diversity and social justice, and measuring inclusion and belonging as part of our regular employee engagement surveys.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>NMI is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation or sexual identity, genetic information, citizen status (except those that do not have the legal right to be employed in the United States), disability, military service, service member, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Please be aware that all offers of employment are made subject to receipt of satisfactory background and financial checks.</p> <p>Attention job applicants: Please note that in compliance with the data protection regulations within your jurisdiction, any personal information submitted with your job application may be collected and used by NMI for the purpose of recruitment and employment-related activities. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and provide explicit consent to the processing of your personal information as described in our privacy policy found on our website. The team’s mission is to move the engineering organization from reactive incident response toward intentional, engineered reliability through strong systems, tooling, and standards.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer, you will operate beyond a single service or codebase, designing and building reliability frameworks, platform capabilities, and guardrails that improve uptime, observability, and operational confidence. This is a highly hands-on role with strong expectations around technical leadership, ownership, and delivery.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build reliability-focused frameworks, tooling, and standards that improve platform uptime, performance, and operational confidence.</li> <li>Drive initiatives that move reliability from reactive response to proactive engineering, emphasizing prevention, early detection, and fast recovery.</li> <li>Partner with engineering teams to embed reliability into system design, development practices, and deployment workflows.</li> <li>Establish and evolve observability practices, including metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards that enable clear operational insight.</li> <li>Identify systemic risks and failure patterns, and lead efforts to address them through automation, architectural improvements, and process refinement.</li> <li>Contribute hands-on to production codebases, internal tools, and platform services with a focus on long-term maintainability.</li> <li>Influence technical direction across teams through design reviews, technical proposals, and clear written communication.</li> <li>Improve operational maturity through better incident practices, post-incident learning, and continuous improvement loops.</li> <li>Mentor engineers by modeling strong ownership, technical judgment, and disciplined delivery.</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations, with a clear mandate to reduce operational load over time through engineering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience building and operating production-grade software systems in complex environments.</li> <li>Strong experience developing backend services in PHP, with the ability and desire to work language-agnostically and quickly learn new languages, frameworks, and codebases as needed.</li> <li>Proven experience working on reliable, scalable, and highly available systems, with a clear understanding of tradeoffs in performance, resilience, and maintainability.</li> <li>Practical experience designing or contributing to platform-level reliability solutions, such as observability tooling, alerting strategies, or reliability standards.</li> <li>Solid understanding of distributed system fundamentals, including failure modes, latency, capacity, and graceful degradation.</li> <li>Experience defining and improving operational practices, including incident response, post-incident reviews, and preventative engineering.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of relational databases and data access patterns, with an operational mindset toward performance and reliability.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments (AWS or equivalent).</li> <li>Familiarity with secure, compliance-aware development practices (eg: PCI, SOC 2, OWASP).</li> <li>Ability to influence technical direction across teams through clear communication, sound judgment, and collaboration.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Annual bonus scheme dependent on individual and company performance&nbsp;</li> <li>Annual salary of £50,000 - £60,000</li> <li>25 days holiday each year (+ bank holidays + 1 day after each year of service with up to a max. of 30 days)</li> <li>Workplace pension scheme</li> <li>Private medical insurance (upon 30 days of employment)</li> <li>7 hours per day, 35 hours per week</li> <li>A remote first culture</li> <li>Great work-life balance with our Flexi-time policy</li> <li>Family Friendly policies (Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay and Shared Parental Leave).</li> <li>A chance to develop with an allocated company training budget</li> <li>Bike2Work Scheme</li> <li>Lifeworks, an Employee Assistance Programme which offers wellbeing, family and financial support services, such as assessments, resources and even 1:1 counselling sessions. It also offers interesting perks such as discounts on gyms, restaurants, high street retailers and cinema tickets</li> <li>A strong commitment to employee wellbeing including mental health first aiders</li> <li>Employee referral scheme with generous financial reward</li> <li>Bonusly colleague reward scheme</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we do!</strong></p> <p>NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We’re the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We’re creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what’s possible so they can think about what’s next. But we’re not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. We’re all about enabling more payments in more ways and more places.</p> <p>We believe that having a diverse group of employees strengthens both our work and our workplace. title: Senior Software Engineer (Android)
description: <p><strong>About Tripadvisor</strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p><strong>Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering</strong> is the team that builds and supports the <strong>world's leading marketplace for travel experiences</strong>. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior Software Engineer (Android)</strong>&nbsp;to join our fast-growing mobile team. This role is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally within 1–2 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford or London. We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments.</p> <p>Within Tripadvisor Experiences we have a fun and friendly environment where the key objective is getting things done. Working closely alongside product managers and designers, our engineers are part of the full process from software design, to code, to test, to deployment and back again. Most of our engineers release code to production every few days and we have a daily release cycle.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Code! Our engineers focus on doing what they enjoy most and do best, writing code</li> <li>Touch code at every level – while the focus is app development, you’ll also have opportunities to work on backend microservices</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Product and design teams to define feature specifications and develop high quality deliverables for our customers</li> <li>Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering, from design to implementation, development experience, QA and maintenance</li> <li>Work alongside other engineering groups located around the world.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience of developing an Android app and familiarity with mobile web and back-end technologies would be beneficial</li> <li>At least 5 years’ experience of commercial software development, solving different kinds of technical problems</li> <li>Experience with reactive programming in native mobile platforms</li> <li>Willingness and ability to take on new technologies</li> <li>Ability to break down complex problems into simple solutions</li> <li>High quality verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Sense of ownership and pride in your work.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive compensation packages</strong>, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.</li> <li><strong>“Work your way”</strong> with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Flexible schedule</strong>. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li><strong>Donation matching</strong>. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li><strong>Tuition assistance</strong>. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li><strong>Lifestyle benefit</strong>. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li><strong>Travel perks</strong>. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li><strong>Employee assistance program</strong>. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li><strong>Health benefits</strong>. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li><strong>Generous referral scheme.</strong> Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Traveller first: </strong>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Execution is our edge: </strong>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>We succeed together: </strong>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</li> </ul> <p>Discover more in our <a href="https://medium.com/tripadvisor">Tech Blog</a>, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our <a href="http://www.purpose.tripadvisor.com/diversity">ED&amp;I strategy </a>shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at ----- <p>If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at ----- We have all the answers!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#Tripadvisor&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
